prompt: Write your AI Use Plan: one or two sentences for each part: tasks you will use AI for, tasks you will keep, how you will ask, how you will check, what you will never share, and how you will disclose.

criteria.label: Use and keep are clear
criteria.look_for: support tasks for AI and core skills kept for yourself

criteria.label: Asking and checking routine
criteria.look_for: a request template and a concrete checking routine

criteria.label: Privacy and disclosure rules
criteria.look_for: what will never be shared and a disclosure sentence

reference: Use AI for: grammar checks and practice questions. Keep: my arguments and lab analysis. Ask: goal, context, constraints, format. Check: find the original source for every fact or citation. Never share: my ID, health details or classmates' work. Disclose: tool, what for, what I changed.
